text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, as the Victoria Mile drew near— 
Line Craft had a dream. The distant sound 
of children's laughter...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
When she woke up, Cesario was peering down 
at her with concern, wondering if she was 
exhausted after taking such a long nap.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Rhein Kraft replied that she was fired up 
instead. After all, the Tiara Umamusume 
she looked up to were running and getting 
the crowd roaring.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"That's why she wanted to run an amazing 
race too. Next, it was their turn as the 
new generation of Tiara Umamusume to hype 
things up."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And on the day of the Victoria Mile, Rhine 
Kraft declares to her peers that she will 
become the number one Tiara Umamusume.
